Dana: morning all — quick standup: yesterday finished promptset pruning for synthia v2, ran evals and saw a spike in repetition on long-context. PR #452 has fixes but needs review. blocking: can't repro a batch-level regression locally; need someone with dedicated GPU to run a full sweep. today: deploy PR, trigger full eval sweep, pair on failing examples later.

Hiro: on it — i'll run the sweep on dedicated tomorrow morning. can you paste the failing prompt ids?

Dana: sure: `prompt_138`, `prompt_142`, `prompt_199`

Sam: quick note — eval-bot flagged a BLEU drop on the Spanish set after quant. rolling back quant profile helped. maybe try disabling KV cache for those tests? :thinking_face: 

Dana: good catch. I'll run with cache disabled. PR now includes a flag `--kv-cache=false` in the eval harness.

Maria: I can review #452 after lunch. also adding a small prompt augmentation to cover LONGCTX edge cases. ping me when you push the commit.

eval-bot: EVAL: synthia-v2 longctx sweep started (job 7832). current: 0/1200. link: https://ci.redwood/evals/7832 

Hiro: ran a tiny smoke locally — can't repro either. leaving a note in the PR about env differences (CUDA 11 vs 12).

Dana: thanks. blocker lifted-ish: trying on dedicated now. also found tokenizer char-escape bug — quick fix is `s.replace('\
','\
')` in utils/tokenize.py; will push shortly.

Sam: LGTM. heads up: codeowners for eval harness are @maria and @ken — if you want quicker turnarounds add ken as reviewer.

Ken: on review queue. I can take it after 3pm PT.

Dana: cool. nothing else for me. -Dana :v:
